data.one_liner: Prevent bad git commit or push using Dart and Flutter, similar to Husky.
data.what_it_does: It allows developers to set up git hooks using Dart code to run checks like tests or static analysis before a commit or push is made. If the script returns false, the git operation is interrupted.
use_when: You want to enforce pre-commit static analysis or code formatting in Dart/Flutter projects
You prefer writing your git hooks in Dart instead of shell scripts
avoid_when: Your project does not use Dart or Flutter
You prefer traditional native shell-based git hooks
strengths: Write git hooks using familiar Dart code
Supports a wide range of git hooks via an enum
Easy initialization using shell commands or Dart code
weaknesses: Relies on Dart environment setup for git hooks execution
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies, run pub get, and initialize via the CLI tool or Dart code.
